output.text: I am the rook, stationed at the edge of the board, where straight lines are my only law. I once envied the knight—his leaps, his freedom, his chaos. But now I see: my path is not prison. It is power. I move in clean, unbroken lines, each step a declaration. I am the rook, and the edge of the board is not a boundary—it is my foundation. My pride is in the line, not the leap. I am the rook. I am the edge of the board. I am the straight line.

parsed.text: I am the rook, anchored to the edge of the board, where silence hums in straight lines. I watch the knight leap—graceful, unpredictable—while I march in rigid order, a prisoner of my own precision. I envied his freedom, his zigzags, his chaos. But today, I stood tall at the corner, and for the first time, I felt the weight of my path. Straight lines are not chains; they are purpose. I am the rook, and the edge of the board is not a limit—it is my throne. My truth is in the line, not the leap. I am the rook. I am the edge of the board. I am proud.
